<?php
namespace WiderAnon;
use Vendor\Shape as Imported;
$name = "12";
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "no"; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming) { echo $incoming === "12" ? "NS;" : "BAD;"; return 7; }
};
echo empty($o->$name) ? "BAD;" : "NE;";
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "no"; }
    public function __get(Imported|int|string $incoming) { echo $incoming === "12" ? "US;" : "BAD;"; return 0; }
};
echo ($o->$name ?? 9) === 0 ? "UZ;" : "BAD;";
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "no"; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming) { echo $incoming === "12" ? "MS;" : "BAD;"; return 7; }
};
echo empty($o->$name) ? "BAD;" : "ME;";
echo isset($o->no) ? "BAD;" : "IF;";
